en_title: Capcom Doubles Down on Movie Strategy After Street Fighter Film's Box Office Debut
cn_title: 《街头霸王》电影票房首映后，卡普空进一步坚定电影战略
opus_summary: 卡普空在11月2日的投资者关系报告中称赞《街头霸王》电影首周末的票房表现，并重申将继续推进游戏内容的多元化使用策略，拓展周边、活动、电竞及可能的更多电影。影片次周票房下跌72%，续集前景不明。

paragraphs.en: In a November 2 investor relations report, Capcom celebrated the Street Fighter film’s success at the box office during its opening weekend and doubled down on its plan to keep expanding its IP through merchandise, events, esports, and possibly more movies.
paragraphs.cn: 在11月2日发布的一份投资者关系报告中，卡普空庆祝《街头霸王》电影首映周末取得的票房成功，并进一步坚定了通过周边商品、活动、电子竞技以及可能推出更多电影来持续拓展其IP的计划。

paragraphs.en: Capcom and Legendary’s Street Fighter movie might’ve hurricane-kicked its way to number one at the box office during its opening weekend, but the stark drop-off it suffered in the following weeks has painted a grim picture for the possibility of a sequel. (The film suffered a 72% drop in its second week , with estimates saying it earned around $91.9 million globally on a reported $80 million budget.)
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空与Legendary的《街头霸王》电影或许凭借旋风腿踢上了首映周末票房榜首，但此后几周票房大幅下跌，让推出续集的前景显得黯淡。（该片第二周票房下跌72%；据估计，其全球票房约为9190万美元，而据报道制作预算为8000万美元。）

paragraphs.en: Despite this, Capcom has celebrated the film’s opening-weekend success with its investors, and says that it remains committed to pursuing its Single Content Multiple Usage strategy.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，卡普空仍与投资者共同庆祝了该片首映周末的成功，并表示将继续致力于推行其「单一内容多种用途」战略。

paragraphs.en: What exactly is that strategy, you ask? Good question: Capcom announced it in a 2023 integrated report , where it defined the plan as a way to “utilize our popular proprietary content for multiple game platforms” by “actively turning it into movies, theater productions, and other non-game media.” Basically, it means that it's pushing the visibility of its games by ramping up marketing, merchandise, crossovers, and, of course, movies.
paragraphs.cn: 你可能会问，这项战略究竟是什么？问得好：卡普空在2023年的一份综合报告中公布了这一战略，将其定义为通过「积极将其改编成电影、舞台剧和其他非游戏媒体作品」，来「为多个游戏平台利用我们广受欢迎的自有内容」。基本上，这意味着卡普空正通过加大营销、推出周边商品、开展跨界联动，当然还有制作电影，来提高旗下游戏的知名度。

paragraphs.en: In its latest investor relations report , Capcom reaffirmed its intention to continue pursuing this strategy in direct relation to the Street Fighter movie’s opening-week financials.
paragraphs.cn: 在最新的投资者关系报告中，卡普空结合《街头霸王》电影首周的财务表现，重申了继续推行这一战略的意向。

paragraphs.en: “In conjunction with the film’s release, Capcom worked to appeal to a broad audience with initiatives that included a worldwide promotional tour, film premiere events in Japan and the U.S., as well as collaborations with game titles, resulting in the film garnering popularity across the globe,” the report reads.
paragraphs.cn: 报告写道：「配合影片上映，卡普空通过全球巡回宣传、在日本和美国举办电影首映活动以及与游戏作品联动等举措，努力吸引广泛观众，使影片在全球广受欢迎。」

paragraphs.en: “Capcom is firmly committed to advancing the multifaceted use of its extensive portfolio of game content, guided by its Single Content Multiple Usage strategy, in order to achieve sustainable growth and enhance corporate value.”
paragraphs.cn: 「卡普空坚定致力于在‘单一内容多种用途’战略的指导下，推进对旗下丰富游戏内容组合的多方面利用，以实现可持续增长并提升企业价值。」

paragraphs.en: This news comes as a mild surprise, given the apparent financial loss on Legendary’s side of things now that two weeks have passed. However, there’s a big push from the talent involved to make another movie, as told to us in several cast interviews . In fact, Olivier Richters — the actor who portrayed Zangief — revealed that the entire cast signed on for three films , which explains why the movie left on such a big cliffhanger and why we saw so little of some of our favorite fighters.
paragraphs.cn: 考虑到两周过去后Legendary方面显然出现了财务亏损，这一消息多少有些令人意外。不过，正如我们在多次演员采访中了解到的，参与影片的演职人员正大力推动再拍一部电影。事实上，饰演桑吉尔夫的演员奥利维尔·里希特斯透露，所有演员都签约出演三部电影，这解释了为什么影片结尾留下了如此大的悬念，以及为什么我们喜爱的一些格斗家出场如此之少。

paragraphs.en: “When they asked me to play Zangief, it was all very clear. There was one goal: Show a [glimpse] of Zangief and his power, so we all want more," he wrote in a YouTube comment. "All actors, including me, signed for three movies. ‘If a sequel is made, Zangief will shine,’ was the promise. Apart from that, you can't expect, from a two-hour movie with so many characters, for everyone to shine in the first part.”
paragraphs.cn: 他在一条YouTube评论中写道：「当他们邀请我饰演桑吉尔夫时，一切都说得很清楚。目标只有一个：让大家［一窥］桑吉尔夫和他的力量，从而让我们都想看更多。包括我在内的所有演员都签约出演三部电影。他们承诺的是‘如果拍续集，桑吉尔夫就会大放异彩’。除此之外，一部两个小时的电影有这么多角色，你不能指望每个人都在第一部中大放异彩。」

paragraphs.en: The overall sentiment from fans and movie-goers was rather positive toward the comedic, fist-flinging flick, though critics were less receptive to it overall. IGN scored Street Fighter a 6 out of 10 , with reviewer Tom Jorgensen saying it “benefits from a very enthusiastic cast and an anarchic spirit, but Kitao Sakurai’s adaptation of the Capcom games struggles to focus all that energy into a well-told story.”
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝和观众对这部充满喜剧和拳脚的影片总体评价相当正面，但影评人整体上对它的接受程度较低。IGN给《街头霸王》打了6分，满分10分，评论员Tom Jorgensen表示，影片「得益于一群热情洋溢的演员和一种无拘无束的精神，但樱井北恩对卡普空游戏的这次改编难以将所有这些活力凝聚成一个讲述出色的故事」。
